book.name: Motmangtiitwu
book.title: MOTMANGTIITWU Ni Joon Suh Wuungbaat Arah

content: Erah lih adi juusih nawa siithinyakhah esiit dokkhoom wangha rah japtuptang. Herong asih eno hekhoh sinat angta; eno herong rookwet ni luuwang khopok angta, erah damdi hekhoh rookwet ni Rangte kaanju men raangta.

Siithinyakhah ah sasaang likhiik angta, helah ah sap lah likhiik, hetui ah angkoleh sakhobung tui likhiik angta. Dragoon ah ih siithinyakhah asuh heteewah chaan, luuwang tongtheng nyia hechaan hephaan thoontang kota.
Siithinyakhah khoh esiit ah ma choi angta, enoothong ma ah deechoi angta. Hah ni mathan mina angta erah loong ah paatja rum ano heh lilih ih phanjoh rumta.

Dragoon ah ih heh chaan ah siithinyakhah asuh kot kano mirep miraang ih phoongpha ano khorongngot rumta. Siithinyakhah ah uh soomtu eh rumta eno li rumta, “Siithinyakhah likhiik o ah? Heh damdoh o jen mui ah?”
Siithinyakhah ah ngaampook ngaamsaang ih Rangte kaanju jengkhaap ah jeng thukta, eno heh suh rookbaji laanyi raangtaan ih chaan kota.
Eno Rangte nyia heh men, adoleh heh maradi tongla hah ah, adoleh rangmong ni o songtongla erah loong ah phang tam rumta.
Heh ih Rangte mina loong damdi mui thuk ano jen thukta, eno heh suh jaat apaat rep, deek akaan rep, jengrep kongrep jengla nyia kurep wangrep loong ah pan suh chaan kota.
Hah ni songtongla miloong ah ih soomtu rum ah, arah mongrep maang dongsiit kaadi roidong ething leedap ni men raangthiin choi nyia etek haat eta Saapsah mina loong luulu ih ba tasoomtu rumka.
“Boichaat an, sen na je anbah ah!
O mina jootsak etheng ah amiimi ih joosak ah, o lang ih tekdok theng ah amiimi ih tekdok ah. Erah langla, Rangte mina loong ah ih enaan etheng nyia laalom laabi eh ang theng.”
Erah lih adi hah mong nawa dong raaha rah siithinyakhah esiit weetup tang. Heh rong ah saapsah rong likhiik enyi angta, eno heh jeng ah angkoleh dragoon jeng likhiik ih angta.
Jaakhoh dowa siithinyakhah chaan aphaan ah heh pandi maakta. Hah ni tongtongla nyia mina loong asuh hema deechoi siithinyakhah ah soomtu thuk rumta.
Erah lih dowa siithinyakhah ah ih paatjaajih loong ah reeraang eta; mirep miraang miksok di heh ih rangmong nawa we kaat thuk taha.

Eno jaakhoh dowa siithinyakhah ah ngathong ni paatjaajih loong ah noisok kano hah ni songtongla mina loong ah mokwaanta. Lih dowa siithinyakhah rah ih jaakhoh ni lang ih maadook arah deeta siithinyakhah ah choomjoot thuk suh heh laaphaang ah hoonthuk eh rumta.

Eno lih dowa siithinyakhah ah ih jaakhoh dowa siithinyakhah laaphaang ah heh tak ih lun motta, tiimnge liidoh erah heh laaphaang ah miijeng toom e ah nyia o ih lasoomtu ka erah loong ah toom tek haat ah ngeh ah.
Erah siithinyakhah ah ih mirep miraang, ehin elong, changthih changteng, dah nyia dah lah angka loongtang suh neng lak dakmiiko lah angka neng khang ni thoikatkat ih heh sin hoon thuk rumta.
Erah sin hoonha ah lajeeka bah o ih uh tiim uh tami sangka adoleh riik uh tami reka, erah raangthuk rumha langla siithinyakhah ah men lah angka heh nomboot ang ah.
Arah jat suh mongtham eje ang theng. O jatwah jeewah ang ah, erah tiim suh liiha nyia marah siithinyakhah ah erah jat ih an, heh nomboot ah 666 ang ah.
